items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Any band that went to the Apollo Theatre, they would go find Joe Keyes and hire him to play that first thing

ctx.x: Oh. Now, there would be a reason then why possibly he went, but Joe Jones told me that Joe Keyes was a marvelous musician.
You know what? Any band that went to the Apollo Theatre, they would go find Joe Keyes and hire
him to play that first thing and carry that band through. He played those shows, play the man's arrangements just like he had been playing in the band forever.
